title: Before You Walk Out the Door, Put On God's Armor 🙏 | Morning Prayer (Ephesians 6)
description:
Pray through the armour of God for an honest, peaceful and courageous morning, with KJV Scripture and a practical commitment for today.

Subscribe and pray with us every morning and every night.

Chapters
0:00 Begin in God's strength
4:36 Truth and righteousness for today
6:24 Walk with the gospel of peace
7:33 Faith when pressure rises
9:24 Guard your mind with salvation and Scripture
11:18 Carry God's Word into the day
14:38 One thing to do today
